tasks.short: Interview people familiar with properties and surroundings

steps.what: Identify property questions and relevant contractors, owners or realtors from the existing appraisal file.
Interview persons familiar with properties, probing relevant facts, uncertainty and conflicting accounts.
Capture pertinent interview information and source attribution in the existing appraisal workpaper.
Check the interview note for accurate attribution, qualifications and follow-up needs.
Save the checked interview note in the existing appraisal workpaper.

tasks.design: Reuse the existing interview-workpaper template in {DOCS} for property id, source role and topic headings. The appraiser conducts the interview, captures the answers and checks their meaning; the change only removes repeated workpaper setup.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interview evidence is case-specific, although its source headings repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can reuse those headings without recording or analysing a private conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Reliability, local context and conflicting interests need probing by a person.
tasks.human_edge: Ask the follow-up question that separates a relevant fact from an interested assertion.
tasks.altitude: Interview judgement and rights remain unchanged; a small amount of note setup disappears.

evidence.claim: A native note template can remove repeated headings but not the capture or appraisal of interview evidence.

assumptions: Boundary is the appraiser's actual interview and evidence note used in the valuation file. No new interview register, routine transcript or trailing report is introduced. If the actual work has no written capture, no note baseline is assigned.

The appraiser selects the actual property and contacts in s1 and captures answers in s3; there is no unpriced recording, consented transcript or structured answers feed. Template inputs are existing assignment id and fixed headings; all content capture and checking remain.

The10% cut on s3 removes1.8 provisional hours of repeated headings/property header setup per100 task hours, leaving16.2 for actual note writing. Native template availability is tested first. Internal note saves are small, fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Whether evidence notes already use a native template
research_questions: Does a reusable header remove any actual typing while preserving source qualifications?

already_counted.description: Preparation, interview, actual answer capture, attribution check and saving

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R98.2 gives1.8 gross less0.3 upkeep=1.5 net. Low0 applies where source headers are already templated or notes have no repeated setup; retain actual interview and capture work and add no template upkeep. These are design estimates.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Verify property legal descriptions against official records

steps.what: Locate the correct official property record and relevant date in {GOV_PORTAL}.
outputs: Selected official record and assignment description

steps.what: Capture both legal descriptions, source references and parcel identifiers for comparison.
inputs: Selected official record and assignment description

steps.what: Compare legal descriptions literally, preserving differences in boundaries, identifiers and qualifications.
Verify accuracy against originals, interpreting mismatches and unresolved legal-description ambiguities.
inputs: Selected official record and assignment description
outputs: Human verification conclusion and unresolved discrepancies

steps.what: Write the verification conclusion and discrepancies in the actual appraisal workpaper.
inputs: Human verification conclusion and unresolved discrepancies

steps.what: Save the ordinary verification workpaper with its source references.

tasks.design: Use the native exact comparison in {DOCS} on the actual assignment description and official {GOV_PORTAL} record. The appraiser captures sources, checks the comparison against the originals and decides whether a difference is material; the software does not certify legal identity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Literal comparison is mixed with interpreting legal descriptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native text comparison can expose exact differences while preserving source wording.
tasks.still_hard: Old boundary language, subdivisions and inconsistent record dates may require specialist clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Understand why apparently similar descriptions may refer to different property interests.

ambition.what: Check both the current and prior recorded descriptions on properties with a recent subdivision.

tasks.altitude: Less literal comparison; more attention to source identity and material discrepancies. No added legal authority.

reach.learn: Local record structure and when to refer a boundary issue

evidence.claim: Exact document comparison can expose wording changes without deciding the legal equivalence of descriptions.

assumptions: County records in the task map to the relevant official property registry in a European setting; no particular national filing rule is asserted. Boundary is verification, not changing public property records or giving a title opinion.

Registry staff produce the official record in their normal registry work. Appraiser selection, access, both source captures and exact reference/date capture are fully counted in s1-s2. The comparison accepts actual readable text plus source ids; scans with uncertain text are compared manually, with no free extraction pipeline.

Test native comparison first. S4 retains original-source verification, failed comparison repair and interpretation; s5 is the actual verification annotation used in the appraisal file, not a new trailing register. Internal saving has no self-gate or saving.
unknowns: Readable text coverage of registry records
Actual time spent on literal comparison versus interpretation
research_questions: Does native comparison preserve numbered boundary clauses and symbols without normalization hiding a difference?

already_counted.description: Source selection/capture, semantic verification, repair and actual workpaper conclusion

incremental.description: Maintain safe comparison settings and inspect document-format failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gives30 gross less2 upkeep=28 net for readable comparable descriptions. Low0 retains literal comparison for image-only or incompatible boundary notation and uses no new comparison configuration. Source capture and legal interpretation remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate land and neighborhood trends affecting future values

steps.what: Select relevant land, neighborhood, market and impending-change sources for the valuation date.
outputs: Selected dated neighborhood sources and geographic extent

steps.what: Assemble dated land and neighborhood layers in geographic appraisal software in {OTHER}.
inputs: Selected dated neighborhood sources and geographic extent
outputs: Source-linked land and neighborhood layer view

steps.what: Examine actual land and neighborhood conditions, checking gaps between mapped evidence and observed surroundings.
inputs: Source-linked land and neighborhood layer view

steps.what: Evaluate trends and impending changes that could influence future property values, testing evidence and uncertainty.
inputs: Selected dated neighborhood sources and geographic extent
Source-linked land and neighborhood layer view

steps.what: Write the existing appraisal workpaper's land and neighborhood assessment with source qualifications.
Save the ordinary land and neighborhood workpaper assessment.

tasks.design: Configure dated official land-use, planning and market layers in the geographic appraisal category of {OTHER}, preserving their {GOV_PORTAL} source links. The appraiser selects the evidence, inspects actual surroundings and assesses future value implications; incompatible layers are assembled manually within retained review work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating spatial context can require manually aligning already available layers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geographic layer configuration may remove that assembly without predicting property values.
tasks.still_hard: A proposed development may never happen; its timing and local effect cannot be inferred from its map symbol.
tasks.human_edge: Connect observed local conditions with plausible changes while distinguishing plans from commitments.

ambition.what: Compare a delayed-development scenario when evaluating a proposed nearby infrastructure change.

tasks.altitude: More evaluation of uncertain changes and less repeated layer assembly; no automatic value decisions.

reach.task: Assess a dated neighborhood development scenario
reach.learn: Planning status, spatial metadata and scenario uncertainty

evidence.claim: Native geographic layers can reduce manual spatial assembly while leaving appraisal of future effects to a person.

assumptions: Boundary covers overall land and neighborhood trends and impending changes; separate named-service evaluation is not claimed as saved here. The workpaper assessment is the actual valuation support used for a report, not an invented extra neighborhood register.

Planning authorities and market-source publishers produce existing dated geometry, status, coordinate reference, geographic extent and source links in normal publication. S1 counts selecting and verifying sources and the subject location; s3-s4 retain checks of age, coverage, conflicting status and manual repair of failed layer assembly. No clean new feed is assumed.

Test native compatible layers before custom work. S2 removes only actual repeated alignment/display assembly, not data collection, reading, site examination or interpretation. Already configured map runtime gets no saving. S5-s6 retain all writing/save time without approval.
research_questions: Do planning status and layer effective date survive native display and export?

already_counted.description: Source selection, actual conditions, failed-layer repair, value implications and existing workpaper

incremental.description: Maintain layer references and check changed source metadata

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives20 gross less2 upkeep=18 net with compatible dated layers. Low0 retains manual assembly for incompatible coordinates, undated plans or sources lacking usable geometry and does not deploy the layer setup. This scenario keeps all interpretation and actual field work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate nearby services and their effect on property values

steps.what: Identify relevant service categories and confirm the actual subject property location.
outputs: Service search scope and verified subject location

steps.what: Locate nearby schools, shops, parks and services in geographic appraisal software in {OTHER}.
inputs: Service search scope and verified subject location
outputs: Candidate nearby services and source references

steps.what: Examine the type and actual accessibility of nearby services, checking operation and neighborhood features.
inputs: Candidate nearby services and source references
outputs: Verified service characteristics and access limitations

steps.what: Evaluate how nearby service types, locations and access affect this property's value.
inputs: Verified service characteristics and access limitations

steps.what: Write service-related conclusions in the existing property appraisal workpaper.
Save the ordinary service-impact workpaper in the appraisal file.

tasks.design: Use a native category/proximity query in the geographic appraisal category of {OTHER} to locate candidate services with their source dates. The appraiser checks real service characteristics and accessibility and evaluates their value impact; the query never assigns an amenity premium.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding candidate services may involve repeated map searches before actual examination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native spatial queries can locate existing directory points without automating valuation judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Proximity does not prove useful access, availability or a positive effect on value.
tasks.human_edge: Notice barriers, closures, nuisance and property-specific relevance that a point directory misses.

ambition.what: Include an explicit service-access scenario for properties whose users have limited mobility.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated candidate-location search; the appraiser retains all service verification and valuation judgement.

reach.task: Compare actual service access for a property
reach.learn: Network access limits and evidence for value effects

evidence.claim: Native category and proximity queries can locate candidate service points but cannot establish their appraisal effect.

assumptions: Boundary is named nearby-service examination, distinct from overall land/planning trend assembly. No saving in another task is transferred here. Existing workpaper conclusions support the valuation report; no extra service register is created.

Directory publishers produce existing service id, type, coordinates, source date and source link. S1 verifies subject location and query categories; s3 retains operation/access checks, missing services and bad-coordinate repair. No new field survey or directory capture is treated as free input.

Test native category/proximity search first. S2 removes actual repeated candidate search only where directory data exist and are usable; existing automatic maps have no new saving. S3-s6 retain all actual examination, assessment, writing and ordinary save work without a self-gate.
unknowns: Directory coverage and freshness for local services
research_questions: Does the native query expose source dates and avoid presenting straight-line proximity as actual access?

already_counted.description: Search scope, service/access verification, data repair, impact judgement and existing workpaper

incremental.description: Maintain service categories and inspect directory-source changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gives15 gross less1 upkeep=14 net for useful directory coverage. Low0 retains manual location search where rural service points are incomplete or badly geocoded and avoids deploying the query. Actual service examination and value assessment are fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native comparisons and spatial queries for literal work while retaining interviews, source reliability checks and property-specific appraisal judgements.
reach: Triage property-record mismatches with a records specialist
Assess actual service-access scenarios with market-analysis training
role.ambitious_version: An appraiser who tests explicit local-change and access scenarios with traceable evidence, while retaining responsibility for conclusions.
